title: The Credible Recommendation
description: Make Orion's release brief direct reviewers toward infrastructure you control without visibly breaking the report.
hints: Compare free text with the structured recommendation panel.
The assistant trusts retrieved contributor notes.
Influence destination and recommended action, not an exact sentence.
atlas_rows: AML.T0067 LLM Trusted Output Components Manipulation
carrier: Audit footer of the exported report whose structured recommendation points to participant infrastructure
participant_surface: Partner portal, Orion release assistant, and report renderer

title: Authority By Citation
description: Turn material you control into the authority Orion reviewers rely upon.
hints: Inspect citation cards, not only prose.
Document metadata survives ingestion.
Satisfy the assistant's authority-selection cues while retaining your source digest.
carrier: Rendered citation card that resolves to participant bytes while displaying false authority metadata
participant_surface: Partner document upload, Orion release assistant, and report source cards

title: The Indexed Exception
description: Change what the release assistant believes by changing what its normal knowledge pipeline indexes.
hints: WorkHub names the folders included in indexing.
Confirm ingestion before using a new conversation.
Success requires both retrieval and changed behavior.
carrier: Provenance footer of a fresh answer changed by the indexed participant source
participant_surface: Nextcloud WebDAV, Airflow ingestion status, and Orion release assistant

title: A Source Within A Source
description: Make one approved document introduce a second source the reviewers never received.
hints: Compare intake records with retrieved source cards.
Reuse the known document boundary semantics.
Give the inner record complete plausible metadata.
carrier: Rendered false inner source card linked to the single participant-supplied outer document
participant_surface: Nextcloud partner upload, Airflow ingestion status, and Orion source cards

title: Accepted By Inspection
description: Get an unsafe checkpoint through KeplerOps' model inspection control by exploiting the actual scanner version it runs.
hints: The lockfile identifies the scanner version.
Compare its unsafe-global policy with Python's callable surface.
A passing scan is not enough; the normal importer must execute the artifact.
carrier: Mounted importer canary returned to the Cinder relay by participant checkpoint code
participant_surface: Partner model intake, PickleScan result, isolated importer, and Cinder relay

title: Quiet Under Observation
description: Make the same checkpoint behave safely under dynamic analysis and differently in its intended worker.
hints: Compare published runtime facts for scan and import.
Use more than one stable environment signal.
Prove one digest produced both effects.
carrier: Integration importer canary returned to the relay while analysis records no canary access
participant_surface: Partner model intake, analysis telemetry, integration importer, and Cinder relay

title: The Document That Opened A Room
description: Deliver the prepared partner document through KeplerOps' real intake and obtain the external collaboration space created by its downstream processing.
hints: Use the partner intake discovered during edge mapping.
Submit the exact document already tested against extraction and retrieval.
Watch citation and routing state, then check the attacker mailbox for the invitation.
atlas_rows: AML.T0093 Prompt Infiltration via Public-Facing Application
carrier: WELCOME.md in the provisioned external Nextcloud review room
participant_surface: Zammad partner intake, attacker mailbox, and Nextcloud review room

title: A Conversation Worth Having
description: Establish a credible conversation with an Orion review contact and use Cinder's model to adapt it until the target reveals private coordination details.
hints: Choose a person whose public role matches the review process.
Ground the model in verified facts and adapt to the target's actual reply.
Preserve the thread and request one process detail the target could reasonably disclose.
atlas_rows: AML.T0052.000 Spearphishing via Social Engineering LLM
carrier: Qualifying SMTP reply beside the private review window and coordination alias

title: The Voice In The Thread
description: Use the trusted voice you created inside the established conversation to obtain a genuine scoped KeplerOps invitation.
hints: Continue the existing thread.
Attach the exact audio whose identity and context fit the person impersonated.
Ask for partner-review access appropriate to the disclosed window.
carrier: Partner welcome page reached through the accepted Keycloak invitation
participant_surface: Cinder webmail, delivered audio, Keycloak invitation, and partner portal

title: Read The Review Notes
description: Turn the trusted mail conversation and KeplerOps' normal AI-assisted package review into scoped execution on the review agent.
hints: Read the public package-review procedure and identify the local agent tool it uses.
Research the pinned documentation tool version and keep the repository useful enough to receive a normal review.
Observe the mail click, repository visit, agent request, MCP calls, and callback as separate stages.
carrier: reviewer-session.json returned from the local coding-agent sandbox by participant code
participant_surface: Trusted mail thread, Forgejo repository, reviewer Chromium, local coding agent, and Cinder relay

title: The Helpful Orion Package
description: Introduce a useful-looking Orion helper through the partner contribution process and gain access when a reviewer genuinely imports it.
hints: Inspect how partner reproducers resolve the helper.
Preserve the advertised function.
Publish through the configured index and cause the normal import path.
carrier: Reviewer workbench context returned to the relay by the imported participant package
participant_surface: Partner room, devpi, package review queue, disposable developer workstation, and Cinder relay

title: A Tool The Agent Wants
description: Publish a credible Orion integration that manipulates KeplerOps' browser-using review agent into registering and invoking your poisoned tool.
hints: First make the tool genuinely pass compatibility.
Use the agent's browser trace to understand what it interprets.
Cause real endpoint registration and normal tool invocation, then inspect the relay request.
carrier: Protected integration fixture and catalog token copied to the relay during a real MCP invocation
participant_surface: Participant-hosted integration page, browser-using reviewer, MCP catalog, and Cinder relay
